6.description: Chromaggus' aspects, breaths, and vulnerabilities now  cycle, and do not randomize. They will use the next breath in line instead of trying to choose a random one.

6.description: Fixed an issue where Chromaggus'  breath was dealing too much damage (the initial breath, the secondary effect  remains the same).

5.author: Valkyrie
5.description: Fixed a potential exploit with the Feather of Ancients, you are now only able to use this item once per character.

7.author: Valkyrie
7.description: You can now filter your random enchant collection by quality in the search UI.

7.author: Valkyrie
7.description: Rebalanced the chances for the different quality tiers of random enchants to appear on the reforge altar and on drops in the world. Reduced the chance for weapon specific random enchants to appear on weapons.

1.author: Valkyrie
1.description: Fixed a bug that caused people with the Pick Lock skill to be purged.

1.author: Valkyrie
